name: Cunning Stunts
guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts on offer, mixing the four categories to skip the hardest ones [1][2]. Under the Bridges runs are the quickest, while the 130 stunt jumps are the best mapped [1][2]. Track progress under Progress Menu > Activities > Stunts and by region on the map [1].
steps: Open Progress > Activities > Stunts to see your total and per-category counts [1].
Chain the 130 stunt jumps across the map, each counted once when landed [1][2].
Add Under the Bridges flights to close the gap to 250 [1].
The trophy pops on the 250th completed stunt [1][3].

name: Master of None
description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: Try each of the nine activity types once and the trophy pops on the last one [1]. The nine types are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and performing a stunt [1]. Most of these get touched naturally while working the other trophies [1][4].
steps: Check the tracker under Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types you still need [1].
Clear the rare ones deliberately: golf, pool and basketball [1].
The story and the 100% checklist will cover the rest automatically [1].
The trophy pops on the final unseen type [1][3].

name: The Shootist
description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: Earn all 42 gold medals across the 12 shooting range challenges and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. The two ranges are Griffin Shooting Range (6 challenges, 3 medals each) and Rodgers Ranch (6 challenges, 4 medals each) [2]. The golds are required for the 100% checklist as well [1][2].
steps: Visit Griffin Shooting Range and clear its 6 challenges at gold [2].
Move to Rodgers Ranch and gold its 6 challenges [2].
Track the 42-medal total from the range menu [1][2].
The trophy pops on the 42nd gold [1][3].

description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
guide: Win one Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. Winning one race ticks the location permanently, and all 42 races across the 14 sites feed the 100% checklist [1][2].
steps: Filter the map for Top Fun Drones to see the blue icons; they mark within 100 meters [2].
Win one race per location to tick it permanently [1][2].
The trophy pops when the 14th location is won [1][3].

guide: Win 20 different races and the trophy unlocks [1]. There are 40 unique race locations, so you can skip the 20 hardest ones [1][2]. Winning any 30 of 40 feeds the 100% checklist at the same time [2].
steps: Open the race list and pick the shortest street races first [2].
Win 20 distinct events; checkpoint rewinds do not void a win [1][2].
The trophy pops on the 20th different win [1][3].

name: Baited My Tackle
description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Beat Cal in his fishing competition by landing a fish bigger than the one he catches [1][3]. The quest opens after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when Cal texts a purple fishing marker west of Key Lento [1][2]. PowerPyx lists no missable flag for the quest, and the video guide calls it an early-game catch [1][3].
steps: Play Chapter 1's Feng Shui (Meet Cal), the 10th main mission [2].
Wait for Cal's text and follow the purple fishing marker west of Key Lento [1].
Land a fish bigger than Cal's to win the challenge [1][3].
The trophy pops when the quest finishes [1][4].
window: Do the quest as soon as Cal's text marks it west of Key Lento [1]; if it is skipped, the sources still list the questline as available later, so this guide keeps it on the cleanup list only as a safety net [1][3].

name: Stick Fiddler
guide: Finish all levels of any one of the four arcade games and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. Three of the four games play on your home TV console from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck lives in arcade cabinets around the world [1][2]. You only need to reach the end of one game, not every challenge [1].
steps: Pick any of the four games; Tenebrae Lux plays at your home console from Chapter 1 [1][2].
Play it at the home TV or at any arcade cabinet [2].
Reach the end screen of the game once [1][2].
The trophy pops on the finish screen [1][4].

Clear each purple treasure-chest dive he marks, using the metal detector on the ocean floor [1].
Turn in all 7 shipwreck sets; track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees [1].
The trophy pops with the final hand-in [1][3].

name: Strangers & Freaks
description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
guide: Complete 8 mission strands and the trophy unlocks, but only certain questlines count toward it [1][2]. The confirmed counters are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, while the character strands with their own trophies - Kenton, Bret, Andy, Billy, Tyrone - do not count here [1][2]. Watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list to see how many have registered [1].
steps: Clear Kirk's 3-quest Skunk Ape chain, startable in Chapter 1 [2].
Clear Kyle's 3-quest chain in Chapter 2 [2].
Clear Yago's 4-quest racing chain in Chapter 3 [2].
Clear Pilot Pete's deliveries in Chapter 4 [2].
The trophy pops when the 8th counted strand ends [1][3].

name: Positive Mental Attitude
description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida's 10 locations and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. Each spot counts twice if you sit both Jason and Lucia through it, but the trophy wants the spots, not 36 sits [1][2]. The very first meditation at Jason's house is Chapter 1 exclusive and the one risk on the list [1][3].
steps: In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen and follow her to the balcony [1][3].
Choose Accept to bank the Chapter 1 exclusive meditation [1].
Sweep the other 17 spots across the 10 locations, tracking under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations [1][2].
The trophy pops on the 18th spot [1][4].
window: The Jason's-house balcony meditation only exists during Chapter 1 [1][2]; talk to Lucia in the kitchen the morning after Down to Earth, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept [1][3].
